name: Swash
author: Erin Carter
description: Dozens of thin diagonal streaks of light lie in parallel lanes across the frame, like a beach etched at a shallow angle. Each soft-edged capsule of glow surges up-slope and drains back along its own lane on a hash-staggered reciprocation, palette-graded from a bright head to a dim tail, holding a bright accent at the top of each stroke before retreating.

params.label: Surge speed
params.effect: Rate of every lane's up-slope surge and drain-back; the stagger pattern stays fixed while the strokes quicken.

params.label: Lane spacing
params.effect: Perpendicular CSS-pixel distance between streak lanes; small = dense etched field, large = sparse isolated strokes.

params.label: Streak length
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of each light streak from bright head to faded tail.
